headline: Sales shrink and AI spending tips Kuaishou into a loss
summary_short: Revenue of RMB31.6B fell 11.1% y/y, and the company swung to an operating loss of RMB635M from a RMB5.3B profit. Adjusted net profit was RMB790M versus RMB4.99B a year ago.
summary_long: Online marketing fell to RMB17.9B and live streaming to RMB7.8B; other services edged up on games and Kling AI. Gross margin dropped to 48.2% from 54.7%. R&D rose to RMB5.2B as AI investment increased, and R&D was RMB4.58B last quarter. The company reported a loss for the period of RMB959M. Cash was RMB27.6B and it repurchased about HK$1.41B of shares in the quarter. No numeric guidance; it said revenue and profitability may stay under pressure in Q4.
confidence_notes: Figures are from the company's IR release (read via web fetch of the page; the page was summarized by the fetch tool, so exact digits should be checked against the release if used elsewhere). The release does not disclose EPS or capex; the shard's Yahoo EPS value (0.1839 HKD) conflicts with the reported loss and was not used. Y/y percentages for total revenue, adjusted net profit, R&D and gross margin change are computed from the release's reported current and prior-year values. Kling AI revenue was not broken out this quarter. The release is in RMB; the shard tags HKD.

drivers.explanation: The release attributes the decline mainly to lower e-commerce marketing spending, citing the consumer environment and e-commerce competition.
The release ties the decline to its efforts to develop a healthier live streaming ecosystem.
Growth came mainly from games and Kling AI revenue, partly offset by lower e-commerce revenue.
The release refers to increased investment in the company's AI strategy this year.
Management cites short-term pressure from a dynamic consumer environment, competition and softer traffic, and expects AI costs to weigh on near-term profitability.
